days.title: Northern Ascent and Panoramic Peaks
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Fuscher Törl
stops.detail: At the Fuscher Törl, the approximately 1.6 km long Edelweißspitze panoramic road (2571 m above sea level) branches off.

stops.name: Edelweißspitze
stops.detail: It leads from Bruck an der Großglocknerstraße via the two mountain passes Fuscher Törl and Hochtor (tunnel portal 2504 m above sea level, historical pass height 2576 m above sea level) to Heiligenblut am Großglockner and has branches to the Edelweißspitze and the Kaiser-Franz-Josefs-Höhe.

days.title: High Alpine Lakes and Historical Passes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Fuscher Lacke
stops.detail: Afterwards, the road descends to the Fuscher Lacke (2261 m above sea level) and tunnels through the Mittertörl (2375 m above sea level; tunnel height 2335 m above sea level), where the old mule track descends via Wegscheid through the Seidlwinkel Valley into the Rauris.

stops.name: Hochtor
stops.detail: Another tunnel crosses the Salzburg-Carinthian border and the Salzach (Inn)/Drau watershed at the Hochtor (2576 m above sea level; tunnel height 2504 m above sea level).

days.driving: Allow time between these sights; local travel times are not verified and conditions vary.

days.title: Glaciers and Southern Alpine Lodges
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Kaiser-Franz-Josefs-Höhe
stops.detail: Far into the Möll Valley, the glacier road branches off from the main road to the Kaiser-Franz-Josefs-Höhe (2369 m above sea level) at the Pasterze Glacier with a view of the Grossglockner, while the Glockner Road itself leads down to Heiligenblut.

stops.name: Wallackhaus
stops.detail: On the Carinthian side, the Wallackhaus and Schachnern are located along the road.
